text:
Claire (PM): Quick sync — proposed recruitment + feedback hooks for our private beta. Goal: 8–10 partners, 4 with on‑prem needs. Draft invite cadence below. Thoughts?

Raj (Eng): I like the split. Suggest we prioritize partners that already use low‑latency endpoints. Can offer a single Dedicated slot as an incentive for early signups.

Marta (Research): Strong agree on signal design. Recommend 5 core tasks (generate, chat, rerank, embeddings, edge case prompt). Weekly 3‑question survey + recorded session. Add an automated eval job to track regressions.

Sam (Design): UX asks: include a 30m onboarding walkthrough (recorded). We'll produce a short checklist and a quick template for session notes.

Lina (Solutions): Incentives matter — propose $1k credits + priority onboarding for on‑prem. Also need a short privacy addendum for customers doing private deployments. @legal FYI.

Tom (Ops): Ops constraints: on‑prem installs require a pre‑install checklist and a 2‑week validation window. We need SSH access window and a staging image. Documented rollback steps too.

Claire (PM): Cool. Draft invite cadence: 
```
- Week 0: outreach email + short sign‑up form (3 questions)
- Week 1: intake call (30m) + mapping of use cases
- Week 2: onboarding + install (if on‑prem) or dedicated slot allocation
- Weeks 3–8: active beta (weekly checkins + 1 recorded UX session + automated evals)
- Week 9: synthesis + decision on rollout / contract
```
Gating rules: must commit to 2 participants who can run our eval set; willingness to sign NDA or addendum.

Raj (Eng): Rollout plan: start with 2 early partners as canaries. After 1 week look at these metrics: p95 latency < 200ms for typical flows, token error rate < 1%, and KV cache hit > baseline. If green, open 3 more spots.

Marta (Research): Feedback loop proposal: weekly triage (30m) + owners for each bug/regression; monthly synthesis doc that we share with partners. We'll create a lightweight feedback form and a tagging taxonomy.

Sam (Design): Can product commit to 2 prioritised fixes per sprint for beta issues (UX + critical regressions)? :thinking_face:

Claire (PM): Yes — product will reserve a small triage slot. Also adding launch criteria baseline: NPS > 20 for beta use cases, retention on the tasks > 60% across partners, no critical data exposures.

Tom (Ops): @Claire (PM) I'll draft an ops SLA skeleton by Friday and include rollback playbook. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployed beta-invite-template v0.2 to /shared/beta/invite-templates — Claire (PM) pinned it.

Claire (PM): Awesome — I'll consolidate notes and send an updated invite + intake form tomorrow. I'll ping @legal and @sales for pricing/addendum. Thanks everyone :rocket:
